W14

Course home

/courses/:courseId
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S03

Orient the current learner or staff member within one academic course and route to the next published activity. Staff preview must be explicit and never record learner completion.

Entry and return
W06 course cardW05 course taskW09 course resultAccepted W03 invitation
Layout regions
Course headerCode/title, term, role, publication or archive banner; Course navigation: Syllabus, Modules, Coursework, Grades, Announcements, Discussions, Calendar, Groups
Main overviewCurrent module, next personal due work, latest published announcement; Teaching contacts and published office-hour facts
Context railProgress and released-feedback availability for learner; Staff tools and explicit student-preview entry for authorized staff

Permissions
  • Only published/date-eligible material appears to learners.
  • TA tools respect allocation and expiry; policy/release actions absent.
  • Archived access follows institutional retention and current role.
Responsive
  • Course links wrap or use an accessible menu; no horizontal-only navigation.
  • Main course work precedes secondary context when stacked.
Accessibility
  • Course navigation uses links with aria-current, not fabricated ARIA tabs.
  • Preview banner is text and remains visible through scrolling/navigation.
Data
  • Course publication/archive facts, membership and published navigation.
  • Next-work references use the same dates/status as W18/W19.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Unpublished course home cannot leak draft module names.
  • Learner grade card reports availability without showing score in general preview.
  • Exiting preview returns to staff context with no learner completion or submission.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
